name: dealer-platform
description: Multi-dealership website platform — dealer-portal :3000, admin (platform) :3001, frontend (websites) :3002, backend (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL) :4000

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix dealer-portal install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix dealer-portal run build && npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
